description: Maps a whole codebase (or a set of modules) to find the regions no living human can explain — code that exists, runs, and passes tests, but has a bus factor of zero. Built for teams where AI generated code faster than anyone absorbed it. Scans read-only (history, churn, size, criticality), then probes named people with cold behavioral questions — predict what the code does on a concrete input, without reading it — and scores the answer against what the code actually does. A region is owned only when a named human predicted it correctly. Produces a debt map ranked by criticality × unexplainability and a repayment plan, smallest high-value probes first. Use when a team suspects it ships more than it understands, before an incident, a reorg, a handover, or an audit.
name: bus-factor-zero
symptom: The codebase works, but for whole regions of it nobody can say what it does or why.
